$comment: Benchmark / load-test query set for the Contoso Travel Concierge demo. A seed set spanning the workload classes and difficulty levels; extend toward 100+ for production-like runs. Each case tags the 'gate' (lever) it exercises so failures map to a hill-climb step. 'expected' fields support deterministic, reproducible grading; the Foundry custom rubric evaluator (see evaluators/policy-rubric.md) scores the same cases qualitatively. Dates assume as_of 2026-08-21.
